errors.text_span: Стойностите са разположени през интервали от 1

errors.text_span: Очаква се тази скала да представлява броя на примерите, използвани за оценка на точността.
errors.evidence: This sentence is an interpretation of what the axis represents, which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt.

errors.text_span: Линията, отбелязана с синьо, представлява LLaMA 8. Тази линия започва на 82%
errors.evidence: The blue line represents 'LLaMA 8B', not 'LLaMA 8'. It starts at approximately 77.5%, not 82%.

errors.text_span: намалява до 78% в рамките на стойностите на оста X
errors.evidence: The blue line (LLaMA 8B) shows a slight increase from approximately 77.5% to 78.0%; it does not decrease.

errors.text_span: Линията, отбелязана с оранжев, представлява Qwen2. Тази линия започва на 84%
errors.evidence: The orange line (Qwen2) starts at approximately 78.5%, not 84%.

errors.text_span: намалява до 78% и продължава на 78% в рамките на стойностите на оста X.
errors.evidence: The orange line (Qwen2) shows a slight decrease from approximately 78.5% to 77.7%. It does not drop to 78% and then continue flat.

errors.text_span: Линията, отбелязана с зелена, представлява Chat GPT. Тази линия започва на 83%
errors.evidence: The green line (ChatGPT) starts at approximately 84.9%, not 83%.

errors.text_span: намалява до 78% и продължава на 78% в рамките на стойностите на оста X.
errors.evidence: The green line (ChatGPT) shows a slight decrease from ~84.9% to ~84.5% and ends at x=3. It does not decrease to 78%.

errors.text_span: Линията, отбелязана с тъмно оранжево, представлява други. Тази линия започва на 78%, намалява до 78% и продължава на 78% в рамките на стойностите на оста X. Линията е плътна и здрава.
errors.evidence: The entire description of this line is fabricated. There is no 'dark orange' line and no model named 'други' (others) in the figure.
The description fails to mention the markers used for each line (circles for LLaMA 8B, squares for Qwen2, triangles for ChatGPT), which was a specific requirement of the prompt.

errors.text_span: плътна и здрава
errors.evidence: The word 'здрава' (robust/strong) is a subjective and unconventional term to describe a line style in a technical description. 'Плътна' (solid) would suffice.

errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Einheiten von 1 bis 10 beginnen
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately states how the x-axis tick labels are arranged ('in units of 1 to 10'). The actual tick labels are placed at irregular intervals at the values 0, 3, 5, and 10.

errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jeweils 2 % betragen
errors.evidence: The description states that the y-axis tick labels have an interval of 2%. However, the axis clearly shows labels at every 1% increment (78, 79, 80, 81, etc.).

errors.text_span: LLAMA 8
errors.evidence: The model name in the legend is 'LLaMA 8B', not 'LLAMA 8'.

errors.text_span: die bei 82 % bei 0 Shots beginnt
errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line (LLaMA 8B) starts at 82% for 0 shots. The plot shows this value is approximately 77.5%.

errors.text_span: und sich über die x-Achse bis auf 84 % bei 10 Shots hinweg leicht verringert
errors.evidence: This part of the description for the LLaMA 8B line is incorrect. The line does not extend to 10 shots; its last data point is at 5 shots. The value of 84% is fabricated. Additionally, the trend is described as decreasing ('verringert'), but it actually increases from 0 to 5 shots.

errors.text_span: die bei 78 % bei 0 Shots beginnt
errors.evidence: This text span refers to the Qwen2 line. The description states it starts at 78% for 0 shots, but the plot shows the value is clearly higher, at approximately 78.5%.

errors.text_span: die bei 78 % bei 0 Shots beginnt
errors.evidence: This text span refers to the ChatGPT line. The description states it starts at 78% for 0 shots, but the plot shows the value is much higher, at approximately 84.9%.

errors.text_span: und sich über die x-Achse bis auf 82 % bei 10 Shots hinweg leicht verringert
errors.evidence: This part of the description for the ChatGPT line is incorrect. The line does not extend to 10 shots; its last data point is at 3 shots. The value of 82% and the data point at 10 shots are both fabricated.
The description fails to mention the marker shapes for any of the three lines (circles, squares, and triangles), even though the prompt requested a description of markers.
